answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Chartered compost manager record with waste management standing, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 504 aliases would need 504 separate proofs, each costing about 110 POA or 16 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. What carries the falcon here is verification, the pulse of cost is what stops the farm, and the raven of the record keeps every claim checkable. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
